verdict.rationale: Medusa ships an official CLI (documented at docs.medusajs.com/resources/medusa-cli) and a separate Cloud CLI referenced in pricing, giving developers and agentic tooling a scriptable interface to manage Medusa projects. Missing for 10: detailed command reference/usage examples, evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features (e.g., non-interactive/JSON output modes), and independent hands-on confirmation of the CLI beyond doc links.
